AICPA & CIMA reported on December 12, 2024 that 36% of surveyed executives said their companies were at least experimenting with generative AI [e2]. limitations: The technical evidence establishes neither a general solution nor a general impossibility.

The evidence does not define the potential customer population or measure hallucination-caused rejection.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI, like every other generative AI model developer, is incapable of solving ChatGPT's tendency to hallucinate, and this makes it a non-starter for most business customers.

statement.excerpt: Moreover, OpenAI (like every other generative AI model developer) is incapable of solving the critical flaw with ChatGPT, namely its tendency to hallucinate — where it asserts something to be true, when it isn’t. This makes it a non-starter for most business customers, where (obviously) what you write has to be true.

from_speaker: OpenAI (like every other generative AI model developer)
a non-starter for most business customers
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that factual unreliability cannot be practically solved and consequently prevents adoption by more than half of potential business customers.
Solving means making useful general-purpose factual responses reliably truthful; neither a small benchmark improvement nor a system that refuses every question settles this.
The commercial assertion concerns rejection caused by hallucinations, not merely concern about accuracy.
This is assessed as a causal claim, not a forecast with an invented deadline or a historical adoption-rate estimate.
criteria.support_condition: Evidence establishes the general technical limitation and representative business research shows that hallucinations cause a majority of potential business customers to reject adoption.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reproducible general solution defeats the technical assertion, or representative evidence establishes that hallucinations do not make adoption a non-starter for most business customers.

evidence.explanation: The paper documents persistent factual errors and proposes a detection method. Incomplete mitigation does not establish that practical solutions are impossible or quantify business rejection.
Business experimentation provides limited counterweight to the commercial dismissal. It neither establishes majority adoption nor identifies hallucinations as the cause of non-adoption.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Reproducible research measuring false assertions, abstention and useful coverage, together with representative research on hallucination-caused rejection. Support requires both the general limitation and majority rejection. A general practical solution or representative evidence ruling out majority rejection would contradict the claim.
